question_text: Which Azure Storage redundancy tier copies data synchronously across three Azure availability zones in the primary region?
question_description: A company is designing a high-availability architecture for their storage account.
answer_explanation: Zone-redundant storage (ZRS) replicates your Azure Storage data synchronously across three Azure availability zones in the primary region.

question_text: Which TWO of the following services can be used to control inbound traffic to an Azure Virtual Machine? (Choose two)
question_description: Select the two services that provide network access filtering for VMs.
answer_explanation: Network Security Groups (NSGs) and Azure Firewall can filter inbound network traffic to Virtual Machines. Azure Bastion provides secure RDP/SSH connectivity, and Advisor provides best practice recommendations.

question_text: Can a resource in Azure belong to multiple Resource Groups simultaneously?
question_description: Consider Azure Resource Manager hierarchy and scope boundaries.
answer_explanation: A resource can only exist in one Resource Group at any given time. However, resources can be moved between Resource Groups.

question_text: Microsoft Entra ID Free edition supports Conditional Access policies.
question_description: Evaluate feature licensing for Microsoft Entra ID tiers.
answer_explanation: Conditional Access requires Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2 licensing. It is not included in the Free tier.

question_text: Match each Azure Storage service to its appropriate use case. To answer, drag the correct storage service from the left column to the appropriate requirement on the right.
question_description: Each service may be used once, more than once, or not at all.

targets.text: Provides shared file access via SMB 3.0 or NFS protocols
Stores large numbers of messages that can be accessed from anywhere via HTTP/HTTPS
Supports Archive, Cool, and Hot access tiers for unstructured object storage

answer_explanation: Azure Files supports SMB and NFS shares; Azure Queue Storage supports asynchronous messaging; Azure Blob storage provides tiering (Hot, Cool, Cold, Archive) for massive unstructured data.

question_text: You need to configure Azure Backup for an Azure Virtual Machine. In which order should you perform the configuration steps? (Place the steps in sequential order from top to bottom)
question_description: Arrange the steps to successfully back up a VM using a Recovery Services vault.

answer_options.text: Define or select a Backup Policy specifying schedule and retention
Enable backup and select the target Virtual Machine
Trigger an initial backup or await the scheduled backup window

answer_explanation: First create the Recovery Services vault, then define the backup policy, attach the policy to the VM to enable protection, and finally execute the initial backup.

question_text: Classify each Azure service into its corresponding cloud service model (IaaS, PaaS, or SaaS).
question_description: Assign the cloud resources to the correct service model categories.
answer_explanation: Virtual Machines and Virtual Networks are Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS). Azure SQL and App Service are Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS). Microsoft 365 is Software-as-a-Service (SaaS).

question_text: To achieve high availability within a single region across three separate data centers, configure [blank1]. To add read-only access to a secondary paired region, enable [blank2].
question_description: Complete the statements by selecting the correct replication options from each dropdown list.
answer_explanation: ZRS synchronously replicates across three availability zones within the primary region. RA-GRS replicates to a secondary region and enables read access on the secondary endpoint.

question_text: Which Azure CLI command is used to create a new resource group named 'rg-prod' in the 'westeurope' location?
question_description: Enter the complete Azure CLI command syntax below.
correct_answer: az group create --name rg-prod --location westeurope|az group create -n rg-prod -l westeurope|az group create --location westeurope --name rg-prod
answer_explanation: The Azure CLI command is 'az group create --name rg-prod --location westeurope' (or shorthand flags '-n rg-prod -l westeurope'). Multiple valid parameter orderings are accepted via the pipe (|) separator.

question_text: For each of the following statements, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.
question_description: Note: Each correct selection is worth one point.

answer_options.statement: To achieve a hybrid cloud model, a company must always migrate from a private cloud model.
A company can extend the capacity of its internal network by using the public cloud.
In a public cloud model, only guest users at your company can access resources in the cloud.

answer_explanation: 1. No: A hybrid cloud can be created starting from on-premises or public cloud without needing a full prior private cloud. 2. Yes: Cloud bursting and hybrid networking extend capacity. 3. No: Public cloud resources are accessed by authenticated internal users, developers, administrators, or public users depending on configuration.

question_text: In the hub-and-spoke diagram, select the component responsible for centralized routing and stateful traffic inspection between spokes.
question_description: Click on the appropriate architectural component in the diagram.
answer_explanation: Azure Firewall deployed in the central Hub VNet provides centralized East-West and North-South traffic inspection and filtering.

question_text: Which governance solution should you recommend to ensure that developers cannot deploy virtual machine sizes with more than 4 vCPUs in the non-production subscription?
question_description:
Litware Inc. Background:
Litware Inc. has 3 subscriptions: Production, Non-Production, and Sandbox.
The Finance team has reported significant budget overruns due to developers deploying large M-series and G-series VMs in the Non-Production environment.

Technical Requirements:
- Must enforce maximum VM sizing across all Resource Groups in Non-Production.
- Must not affect the Production subscription.
- Existing compliant resources must be audited, and non-compliant deployments must be blocked automatically.

answer_options.text: Assign an Azure Policy with the 'Allowed virtual machine size SKUs' definition scoped to the Non-Production subscription with a 'Deny' effect.
Assign the Reader role to all developers on the Non-Production subscription.
Apply a ReadOnly resource lock to the subscription root.
Configure an Azure Cost Management budget alert with automated runbook action.

answer_explanation: Azure Policy with an 'Allowed virtual machine size SKUs' definition and a 'Deny' effect actively prevents deployments of unapproved VM sizes at the subscription scope. Resource locks prevent deletions or modifications of all resources, and RBAC Reader prevents any deployments at all.
